The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.190/2023 of Police Station Kherwara, Dist. Udaipur for the offence punishable under Sections 376 & 450 of IPC.

He has preferred this second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The first bail application was not pressed with liberty to file afresh after recording statement of the prosecutrix by this Court on 19.12.2023.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that the prosecutrix has been examined in Court as PW-1 and there are material contradictions, omissions and improvements in her statement.
The petitioner is behind the bars since 06.08.2023.
The trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the second bail application.

[2024:RJ-JD:16511] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-4297/2024] Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
